# Ollama Management

This layer is responsible for managing Ollama releases and models, including hashing archive files, updating model pinning, and computing checksums.

## Overview

The Ollama Management layer includes scripts for handling Ollama releases and models.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`scripts/archive-hashes.js`](../scripts/archive-hashes.js) | Lists files in an Ollama release archive. | `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, `field` |
| [`scripts/update-models.js`](../scripts/update-models.js) | Records model pinning digests. | `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, `main` |
| [`scripts/update-ollama.sh`](../scripts/update-ollama.sh) | Computes release and model digests. |  |

## How it works

- `scripts/archive-hashes.js` lists files in an Ollama release archive and hashes them using the `hashArchive` and `hashTar` functions.
- `scripts/update-models.js` records model pinning digests by fetching them from a manifest URL and updating the pinning using the `fetchPin` and `pinFromManifest` functions.
- `scripts/update-ollama.sh` computes release and model digests by running the hashing and model update scripts.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `pins/models.json`.
